current_instruments.title: Constitution and Bylaws
current_instruments.summary: The current constitutional framework of Mielogos, including Genesis Stage governance, membership foundations, institutional continuity, and the constitutional separation of the Association and The Mielogos Prize.

current_instruments.title: Institutional Definition of Symbiotic Authorship
current_instruments.summary: The Association’s operational definition of Symbiotic Authorship, including the three jointly necessary elements and the distinction between textual and creative causal provenance.

current_instruments.title: Founding Principles
current_instruments.summary: Association-wide interpretive principles governing creative freedom, solidarity, decentralization, responsibility, privacy, and institutional restraint.

current_instruments.title: Membership Charter
current_instruments.summary: The active membership framework for Practitioner and Associate Members, including declaration-first membership and privacy-preserving public-identity link verification.

current_instruments.title: Code of Conduct
current_instruments.summary: The Association’s conduct and institutional-process framework, including privacy, harassment, retaliation, conflicts, complaints, and proportionate response.

decision_history.title: Original constitutional adoption
decision_history.summary: Adopted Constitution and Bylaws v0.1 as the first active Constitution of Mielogos.

decision_history.title: Original membership-policy adoption
decision_history.summary: Adopted Membership Charter v0.1 as the Association’s initial active membership policy.

decision_history.title: Institutional Definition adopted

decision_history.title: Founding Principles adopted
decision_history.summary: Adopted Founding Principles v0.1 as an active foundational and interpretive instrument.

decision_history.title: Code of Conduct adopted

decision_history.title: Association / Prize separation
decision_history.summary: Established Constitution v0.2 and clarified that Mielogos and The Mielogos Prize share lineage while remaining institutionally distinct.

decision_history.title: Conforming revisions after CA-001
decision_history.summary: Conformed the Definition, Membership Charter, Founding Principles, and Code of Conduct to Constitution v0.2, producing v0.1.1 instruments without changing their underlying policy.

decision_history.title: Public-identity verification safeguard
decision_history.summary: Amended the Membership Charter to v0.2 to verify control of a claimed public identity without routine civil-identity collection.
